body:
Implemented the founder-approved /design clickable prototype into production console.html: replaced the single narrow accordion-stack card with a sidebar nav (Mail/SIP Phone/Account/Admin) and a two-pane Mail view, responsive (collapses to single-pane + horizontal tab strip below 760px). All existing endpoints/business logic unchanged. Commit 2d6d552.

title: Console visual refresh: sidebar nav app shell + responsive two-pane mail
